title: Yarl Geek Challenge Innovation Festival 2026
summary: Participated in and supported the Yarl IT Hub innovation community around YGCIF 2026 in Jaffna.

title: CHiPSAL Regional Symposium in Jaffna
summary: Co-organised the regional Symposium on Challenges in Processing South Asian Languages at the University of Jaffna, with keynotes and panels on linguistic and computational challenges for South Asian languages.

title: LFG 2026 hosted at the University of Jaffna
summary: Served as a local organiser of the 31st International Lexical-Functional Grammar Conference, held in Jaffna from 28–30 July 2026.

title: International Workshop on Computational Sanskrit
summary: Supported the Computational Sanskrit workshop held at the University of Jaffna from 25–27 July 2026 as part of the cluster of language-technology events around LFG 2026.

title: Open Science and Research Data Management training week
summary: Supported an Open Science and Research Data Management training programme at the University of Jaffna through the DigSAL partnership.

title: CeyNews models released on Hugging Face
summary: Released/updated CeyNews models for multilingual Sri Lankan news classification and headline generation through the LTG-UoJ Hugging Face organisation.

title: Tamil Universal Dependencies documentation research stay
summary: Completed a research stay at Charles University focused on Tamil Universal Dependencies documentation and annotation guidelines.

title: CHiPSAL 2026 at LREC
summary: Co-organised the second Workshop on Challenges in Processing South Asian Languages (CHiPSAL 2026), co-located with LREC 2026 in Palma, Mallorca.

title: New Tamil and South Asian NLP publications at LREC 2026
summary: Published work on Tamil linguistic knowledge in LLMs, Tamil hate-speech detection, multimodal low-resource content understanding, and Sri Lankan Tamil speech benchmarking.

title: Dialect-aware Tamil phonetic transcription tool published
summary: Published a VarDial 2026 paper on a dialect-aware phonetic transcription tool supporting Indian and Jaffna Tamil.

title: Tamil OCR evaluation published
summary: Published a comprehensive evaluation of Tamil OCR systems, including survey, dataset construction, benchmarking and error analysis.

title: DAAD Research Ambassador 2025–2028
summary: Recognised as an honorary DAAD Research Ambassador for the 2025–2028 period.

title: Invited talks in Pakistan
summary: Delivered invited talks on challenges in processing South Asian languages at UET Lahore and Mohammad Ali Jinnah University, Karachi.

title: First CHiPSAL workshop at COLING 2025
summary: Co-founded and co-organised the first CHiPSAL workshop, creating a recurring forum for research on South Asian language processing.
